entities.name: Nataša Krsmanović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nataša Krsmanović is a Serbian volleyball player, who plays as a middle-blocker for Seramiksan in Turkish Women's Volleyball League. She was a member of the national teams that won the silver medal at the 2007 European Championship and competed at the 2008 and 2012 Summer Olympics.
